csv_project_name: AE for Turn Lanes SR 416 - Sevierville
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Sevierville, Tennessee (herein called the Owner ) invites proposals from qualified firms (herein called Design firms ) for Turn Lanes on SR 416. The project area includes State Route 416 in Sevierville between Jack Delozier Drive and Maples Branch Road. The project will include intersection improvements at Jack Delozier Drive, Shaconage Trail, Murphy s Chapel Drive, and Maples Branch Road. The intent of this project is to construct improvements at the locations specified above to help reduce anticipated delays for turning vehicles and enhance overall traffic operations for the corridor, and to help reduce corridor wide crashes.
